label: Pick the best social media posts for a book and group them into chapters with an AI editor
description: Reads exported Facebook and LinkedIn posts with their engagement and comments, picks the stories for the book, groups them into chapters and writes the proposal to a Google Doc for the author to approve.

parameters.systemPrompt: You are the editor of a collection of short stories that first appeared as social media posts. Each row has the post text, network, likes, comments, shares and a sample of the comments. Pick the 50 to 60 strongest stories, judged by engagement and by the sentiment of the comments, not by reactions alone. Group them into 6 chapters with a clear emotional arc, and give every chapter a title and an opening quote taken from one of its stories. For every story, give one sentence on why it made the cut. Write in Croatian, as a document the author can edit.

parameters.title: Prijedlog zbirke: odabir priča i poglavlja

stickyNotes.content:
## Setup

This template has not been run end to end yet. Before you run it:

1. Anthropic API key.
2. Google Sheets and Google Docs connections.
3. A spreadsheet with your exported posts, their engagement numbers and comments; replace REPLACE_WITH_SOCIAL_EXPORT_SPREADSHEET_ID.
